example.title: Frank Pisar (Pisar-Kastanek) farmstead, stone barn
example.place: Pleasant Hill vicinity, Saline County, NE

brief: Czech immigrant's barn about 40 ft wide and 60 ft long: low walls of rough-coursed buff limestone only one storey tall, with a centered opening framed by faded red plank doors and a red boarded hay door above, under an enormous, steep gable roof re-covered in grey ribbed steel that runs down almost to the tops of the stone walls. The roof ridge sags slightly; a two-track lane runs through tall grass to the door, a volunteer tree grows against one corner, and a pile of fallen stone lies nearby.
